figs.name: cold-loop-and-hot-loop-testing-cold-loop-setup-diagram
figs.alt: cold loop testing setup with field jumper, junction box, marshalling, I/O card and DCS tag
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a cold loop test path from a jumper at the field end through the junction box and marshalling panel to the I/O card and DCS tag.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Cold loop test setup from field jumper to DCS tag</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cold Loop Test Setup: Field to DCS</text>
<rect x="20" y="90" width="140" height="150" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="90.0" y="124.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Field end</text>
<text x="90.0" y="147.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="90.0" y="170.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Jumper across</text>
<text x="90.0" y="193.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">plus and minus</text>
<text x="90.0" y="216.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">cores</text>
<line x1="160" y1="150" x2="175" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="160" y1="180" x2="175" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="175" y="90" width="140" height="150" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="245.0" y="136.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Junction box</text>
<text x="245.0" y="159.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="245.0" y="182.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Field cable</text>
<text x="245.0" y="205.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">terminals</text>
<line x1="315" y1="150" x2="330" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="315" y1="180" x2="330" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="330" y="90" width="140" height="150" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="136.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Marshalling</text>
<text x="400.0" y="159.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="400.0" y="182.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Multimeter</text>
<text x="400.0" y="205.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reads near 0 Ω</text>
<line x1="470" y1="150" x2="485" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="470" y1="180" x2="485" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="485" y="90" width="140" height="150" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="555.0" y="136.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">I/O card</text>
<text x="555.0" y="159.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="555.0" y="182.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Correct channel</text>
<text x="555.0" y="205.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">per I/O list</text>
<line x1="625" y1="150" x2="640" y2="150" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="625" y1="180" x2="640" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="640" y="90" width="140" height="150" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="710.0" y="136.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DCS or PLC</text>
<text x="710.0" y="159.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle"></text>
<text x="710.0" y="182.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Correct tag,</text>
<text x="710.0" y="205.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">range, units</text>
<text x="400" y="290" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">One continuous path: field, JB, marshalling, I/O card, tag</text>
<rect x="40" y="320" width="340" height="140" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="352" font-size="19" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pass looks like</text>
<text x="210" y="384" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Near zero ohms across cores</text>
<text x="210" y="412" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Shield at panel end only</text>
<text x="210" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 mA = 0 %, 20 mA = 100 %</text>
<rect x="420" y="320" width="340" height="140" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590" y="352" font-size="19" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fail looks like</text>
<text x="590" y="384" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Open circuit: broken core</text>
<text x="590" y="412" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Core to shield short</text>
<text x="590" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Wrong terminal or channel</text>
</svg>

figs.name: cold-loop-and-hot-loop-testing-procedure-flowchart
figs.alt: cold loop testing procedure flowchart for an analog input loop with continuity check
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the seven step cold loop test for an analog input loop, including the continuity check and fault repair path before sign off.
figs.after_h2: Cold Loop Testing Procedure: Step by Step
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Cold loop testing procedure flowchart for an analog input loop</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cold Loop Procedure: Analog Input Loop</text>
<rect x="40" y="56" width="400" height="44" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="83.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1. Verify tag, location and orientation</text>
<line x1="240" y1="100" x2="240" y2="114" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="116" width="400" height="44" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="143.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">2. Free the cable ends at field or JB</text>
<line x1="240" y1="160" x2="240" y2="174" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="176" width="400" height="44" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="203.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">3. Jumper plus and minus cores at field end</text>
<line x1="240" y1="220" x2="240" y2="234" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="236" width="400" height="44" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="263.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4. Check continuity at marshalling terminal</text>
<line x1="240" y1="280" x2="240" y2="294" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="240,298.0 390.0,346 240,394.0 90.0,346" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240" y="352.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Near zero ohms?</text>
<line x1="390" y1="346" x2="470" y2="346" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="430" y="336" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="472" y="302" width="300" height="88" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="622.0" y="328.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Find fault</text>
<text x="622.0" y="351.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">open, short or wrong</text>
<text x="622.0" y="374.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">terminal, then repair</text>
<polyline points="622,302 622,198 442,198" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="240" y1="394" x2="240" y2="414" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="256" y="410" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="40" y="416" width="400" height="44" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="443.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">5. Trace to correct I/O card channel</text>
<line x1="240" y1="460" x2="240" y2="472" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="474" width="400" height="44" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="501.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">6. Confirm tag, range and units in DCS</text>
<line x1="240" y1="518" x2="240" y2="530" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="532" width="400" height="44" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="240.0" y="559.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">7. Record PASS, sign off, remove jumper</text>
</svg>

figs.name: cold-loop-and-hot-loop-testing-commissioning-phases-infographic
figs.alt: cold loop and hot loop testing in the commissioning phases with key differences
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the four commissioning phases, with cold loop testing in pre commissioning and hot loop testing in commissioning, plus key differences.
figs.after_h2: Where Cold and Hot Loop Testing Fit in the Commissioning Sequence

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>

<text x="304" y="186" font-size="17" fill="#0369a1" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">COLD LOOP TEST</text>

<line x1="590" y1="160" x2="604" y2="160" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="608" y="70" width="176" height="180" rx="14" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#047857" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="696" y="102" font-size="18" fill="#047857" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Phase 4</text>
